_comment: Scenario-staged routing demo beside impassable terrain: a brittle player cavalry unit (60 mounts at morale 0.5) starts just west of the default hill (Rect2(1150, 380, 250, 200)) and holds there until an enemy cavalry charge from its WESTERN flank comes in. Both units stand clear of the hill for the whole clip: the router's block is 280 wu wide, so its centre at x=960 keeps its eastern file 50 wu clear of the hill's west face. The pursuer's target sits 190 wu west of the hill and 40 wu below its bottom edge, so its leg is clear of the hill and it charges straight east. Measured with a 2-tick dense state dump: the router holds at its spawn through tick 120, the charge makes contact at tick 159 and drives the router back about 60 wu west, the two fight one unbroken melee, and the router routs at tick 344. While the pursuer is still on it the router is held near where it broke (about (903, 681) at tick 440); once clear it flees north along the hill's west side (about (919, 615) at tick 560, (907, 225) at tick 680), every man clear of the hill, and rallies at tick 704 (ROUTING at 703, IDLE at 704) at about (907, 154), inside the clip (it ends at tick 720). It rallies at its full 221 wu/s flight, so it then pulls up with its men in step (anchor about (906, 135) at tick 710, still coasting at about (906, 105) when the clip ends); its men arrive at the rally already scrambled off their own slots by the interleaved fight (#1725). The pursuer's facing turns smoothly through the charge, with no snap larger than 20 degrees between 2-tick samples. This scenario does NOT show a rout detouring around the hill: the router's flight never meets it. The 'stands and fights when genuinely trapped' case is covered by test_trapped_routing_unit_fights_instead_of_fleeing. No player input needed; the scenario + seed make the clash deterministic. After the rout the router streams out through the pursuer's deep column: the pursuer holds its facing (23 degrees at tick 560) and its slot grid while the router is among its ranks, then turns and rides north after it (facing -86 degrees at tick 600, anchor about (903, 514) at tick 720). A 2-tick scan from the divergence (tick 343) reads the pursuer's sustained shape residual at 13.3 wu against the 30 wu threshold; on main 4fe946a5, where the grid swung round with the facing and the anchor backed away to the south-east, it read 142.2 wu (#1757). Before the charge came straight in (rout at tick 469), the same scan from the rout read 75.4 wu: the straight charge did not cause the deformation. The declared checks pin the router's story beats with sparse post-rout samples (400, 560, 680, the rally at 703/704, and 710) rather than sampling the gallop densely. The router's own scramble (judged only on the 16 ticks after its rally) is declared below as an exemption rather than sampled around.

shape_residual.reason: uid 0 (the router): it rallies at tick 704, and the 16 ticks to the clip's end are its only judged samples (a router is not judged). Its men reach the rally already far off their own slots: at tick 704 they stand 298.6 wu from their own slot on average (index-aligned) and 30.9 wu from the nearest slot, after the fight that starts with the two blocks interleaved. It then pulls up from its 221 wu/s flight (anchor y 153.7 at tick 704, 105.2 at tick 720) with its men in step, and the scramble carries over: sustained shape residual 238.8 wu on 2-tick samples from the divergence (tick 343), against 236.8 wu on main 4fe946a5 and 227.2 wu on main 1f4a77eb, where the anchor stopped dead on the rally. So the residual is the scramble, not the post-rally stop. Tracked by this clip's re-authoring in #1725.

overlap.reason: uid 0 (the router), judged only on the 16 ticks after its rally at tick 704: closest body pair 1.552 wu on 2-tick samples from the divergence (tick 343) against the 5.0 wu floor, 2.758 wu on main 4fe946a5, and 2.408 wu on main 1f4a77eb, where the anchor stopped dead on the rally. Its men reach the rally scrambled off their own slots (see the shape_residual reason), so the close pair is the scramble rather than the post-rally stop; the cause was not traced further. Tracked by this clip's re-authoring in #1725.
